tests.title: Course creation retains the required category across tabs
tests.goal: A course can be created with a selected category and timetable.
preconditions: A category and active timetable are available.
data: QA-only course details and a QA timetable.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Courses & Enrolment > Courses Information > Add New Course.
Enter a unique course name and slug, select an existing category, and set the product type to Hidden Product.
Open Session & Timetable, set one session per purchase, and select an active timetable.
Search the course list for the unique course name.

expected.text: The category remains selected when switching tabs.
The course saves successfully and appears in the course list with the selected category and timetable.
The Hidden Product is not visible in the online store catalog.

checks.label: The category remains selected when switching tabs.
The course saves successfully and appears in the course list with the selected category and timetable.

notes: Category chip appeared after selecting existing Course category, then disappeared on Session & Timetable tab. Save failed twice with exact message: Please select a category! Created QA timetable ID 70, but course was not saved; storefront visibility not reached.
Exploratory course creation: category selection lost across tabs, blocking course save. Enrollment not reached. QA timetable ID 70 was created.
